nodes.name: Receive ScenarioSpec Request
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow trigger. Expected input may include normalized reconciliation payload or webhook-compatible body.

nodes.name: Generate ScenarioSpec
nodes.notes: Python governance API is the source of truth for ScenarioSpec generation. No Isaac, LLM, or TRT mutation happens here.

nodes.name: ScenarioSpec to Isaac Simulation Run
nodes.notes: Starts the generated ScenarioSpec simulation asynchronously. n8n polls /simulation/runs/{run_id} instead of waiting on the full Isaac process.

RunArtifact: ${$json.run_id}. KPI rows were recorded for ${($json.run_artifact?.line_kpis || []).length} lines.`) : `ScenarioSpec was generated, but simulation result processing failed: ${$json.error_code || ($json.errors || []).join('; ') || $json.status}.` } }}

nodes.name: Normalize ScenarioSpec Generation Input

nodes.notes: Prevents FastAPI calls when required ScenarioSpec generation fields are missing.

nodes.notes: Waits briefly before polling the backend simulation status endpoint.

nodes.notes: Polls the async simulation run until a terminal status is returned.

nodes.name: Simulation Run Terminal?
nodes.notes: Routes terminal simulation results to the response envelope; RUNNING loops back to the wait/poll path.
